class.name: NavigationSystem
class.brief_description: Parallel agent pathfinding and navigation controller.
class.description: [NavigationSystem] manages pathfinding logic for ECS entities. it acts as a bridge to [NavigationServer3D], allowing thousands of agents (NPCs, enemies) to query maps, avoid obstacles, and slide along navmesh surfaces. The system supports [b]Asynchronous Path Queries[/b], ensuring that pathfinding calculations for massive crowds do not stall the main thread. Results are delivered back to entities via the [NavigationAgent3DComponent]. [b]Note:[/b] This system requires a valid [NavigationMesh] to be baked and registered on the [NavigationServer3D] separately.

method.name: process_navigation_updates
method.description: Polls the [NavigationServer3D] for path results and updates the target velocities for all active agents.
